server.title: Server Configuration

data_description.api_key: Required for cloud providers. Optional for local servers (LM Studio, llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM): leave blank unless the server needs a key.

openclaw_pairing.title: OpenClaw Device Pairing

data_description.openclaw_session_key: Only used when Session Mode is 'Fixed'. Enter a short key such as 'main' or a full session ID such as agent:main:main.
data_description.hermes_session_key: Stable key scoping Hermes long-term memory for this profile.
data_description.openclaw_agent_id: The OpenClaw agent that answers this profile's requests. It must match an agent configured in OpenClaw. Default is 'main'.
data_description.openclaw_session_mode: 'Per conversation' gives each Home Assistant conversation its own OpenClaw session, so follow-up questions stay in it. 'Fixed' sends every request to the single session set in Session Key.
data_description.system_prompt: Sent to OpenClaw with every request as an extra system prompt, for example to set a persona. Leave blank to use the agent's own prompts. The satellite's room is added automatically.
data_description.thinking_mode: Controls reasoning on models that think before answering. Off is fastest for voice. Server default sends nothing. Not every server honours it (LM Studio is unreliable).

mcp_server.title: Shared MCP Server Settings
mcp_server.description: ⚠️ These settings affect ALL profiles. Changes here will impact every Assist Harness conversation agent.

data_description.searxng_url: Address of your SearXNG instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8888. JSON output must be enabled in its settings.yml (search: formats: json).

import_offer.title: Import from MCP Assist
